description: This Python source file defines functions related to listing and filtering website transaction data in an ERP system, specifically within the 'erpnext' application. It includes context functions for web pages, transaction retrieval functions, and permission checks, focusing on contact-related and transaction listing logic.

methods.name: get_list_context(context=None)
methods.description: Provides context variables for website list pages, including formatting, currency, and transaction list fetching.

methods.name: get_webform_list_context(module)
methods.description: Returns context for webform transaction list if the module is part of 'erpnext'.

methods.name: get_webform_transaction_list(doctype, txt=None, filters=None, limit_start=0, limit_page_length=20, order_by="modified")
methods.description: Fetches a list of transactions for custom doctype webforms, applying filters based on related links.

methods.name: get_transaction_list(doctype, txt=None, filters=None, limit_start=0, limit_page_length=20, order_by="modified", custom=False)
methods.description: Retrieves filtered transaction list data depending on user permissions and doctype specifics, including special handling for RFQ.

methods.name: get_list_for_transactions(doctype, txt, filters, limit_start, limit_page_length=20, ignore_permissions=False, fields=None, order_by=None)
methods.description: Fetches a list of transactions like invoices and orders, with optional text filtering and related item searches.

methods.name: rfq_transaction_list(parties_doctype, doctype, parties, limit_start, limit_page_length)
methods.description: Fetches RFQ-related transactions, specifically supplier RFQs, with post-processing.

methods.name: post_process(doctype, data)
methods.description: Enhances transaction documents with status display info and items preview.

methods.name: get_customers_suppliers(doctype, user)
methods.description: Determines the list of customers and suppliers related to a user based on permissions and contact data.

methods.name: has_website_permission(doc, ptype, user, verbose=False)
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to view a particular document based on customer/supplier relationships.

methods.name: get_customer_filter(doc, customers)
methods.description: Constructs a filter dictionary for customer-related documents.

methods.name: get_customer_field_name(doctype)
methods.description: Returns the appropriate customer field name based on document type.
